about.en: ZZZ is a memecoin on Robinhood Chain at 0x7dbf38976f6d3b9c529e7d9484a71898b409ee6a, named after the 'ZZZ' prefix AI agents were reported to add to wiki edits to push them to the bottom of a review queue. It has no issuer and no claim on anything; it is a meme token traded for its own sake.
